findings.title: Indemnification obligations are carved out of the liability cap
findings.deviation: Clause 9.2 carves out all indemnification obligations from the aggregate liability cap, rather than limiting the carve-out to intellectual property infringement claims.
findings.impact: AtliQ faces unlimited liability for non-IP indemnities, such as third-party claims for property damage or bodily injury under Clause 10.2.
findings.quote: EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE UNDER THE APPLICABLE SOW IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM, EXCEPT FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.
findings.counterPosition: Limit the indemnity carve-out from the liability cap solely to third-party intellectual property infringement claims.

findings.title: Uncapped liability for confidentiality breaches covers data incidents
findings.deviation: Clause 9.2 carves out breach of confidentiality from the general liability cap without any super-cap, resulting in unlimited liability for data security incidents or privacy breaches.
findings.impact: AtliQ could face uncapped liability for data security incidents, which violates the playbook requirement to avoid uncapped liability for data breaches.
findings.quote: EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE UNDER THE APPLICABLE SOW IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM, EXCEPT FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.
findings.counterPosition: Establish a separate, reasonable super-cap (such as 2x fees) for confidentiality and data-protection breaches.

findings.title: Liquidated damages are not specified as the sole remedy
findings.deviation: Clause 11.1 details the calculation of liquidated damages for delay but does not state that they represent the sole and exclusive remedy for such delays.
findings.impact: The client might attempt to seek actual damages in addition to liquidated damages for project delays.
findings.quote: If Vendor fails to complete a milestone by the date specified in the SOW due to causes attributable to Vendor, Lakeshore may assess liquidated damages of one-half percent (0.5%) of the affected Milestone Fee per week of delay, up to a maximum of five percent (5%) of that Milestone Fee.
findings.counterPosition: Specify that liquidated damages are the sole and exclusive remedy for any performance delays.

fine.note: Payment terms of 30 days from invoice receipt are acceptable and align with the playbook.
Deliverables ownership transfer upon full payment and the perpetual license for background Vendor Tools match the standard.
The mutual indemnity for negligence and standard IP infringement protection for deliverables are acceptable.
The 30-day notice for convenience termination with payment for all services performed through the termination date matches the standard.
The mutual non-solicitation clause is standard and contains no non-compete restrictions.
No complex or unreasonable acceptance criteria are included, with a standard warranty re-performance period for non-conforming deliverables.
